external_collaboration.evidence_quote: How can young people learn to take better care of their mental wellbeing while also building creativity, confidence and meaningful connections with others? This was the central idea behind Wellbeing4Youth, an international Erasmus+ youth project bringing together young people from Poland, Italy, Greece, Romania and North Macedonia. The project responded to a challenge that is becoming increasingly visible across Europe: young people experience high levels of stress, pressure
